Jan–Sep plan: $9,615,367.31.
Expenses: $9,686,931.97.
The annual budget is a separate baseline.
Find the pressure points
Expenses are $71,564.66 (0.74%) above plan. Monthly trends and division filters help focus investigation.
Prioritize the follow-up
10 open issues cover $188,892.83 under review. Open an issue for its source, owner and required action.
Identify which divisions drive the variance, then distinguish timing effects from recurring cost pressure.
Budget minus expenses is the variance. Under-review amounts are not established losses.
Separate ownership
County retained: 18.8% of gross receipts. Agency pass-through funds belong to other agencies; they are not County revenue.
Read each control stage

Bank absolute gaps: $12,446.44.
GL clearing: $145,006.39.
These stages are not additive.
Move from gap to evidence
Open a batch to inspect its receipts, banked amount and GL postings. The exception queue provides the accountable owner and follow-up.
Trace the discrepancy to source records and assign reconciliation follow-up before drawing a conclusion.
Pending Not Due bank items are excluded. GL maturity uses an illustrative two-calendar-day buffer.
Start with an as-of balance
Open receivables: $407,695.96. Each invoice is reduced only by payment applications dated on or before September 30.
Rank the aging exposure

Past due: $242,507.80 (59.5% of open A/R).
More than 90 days overdue: $115,248.39. Select a bucket to focus.
Inspect the payment trail
Search, sort and open an invoice to see dated applications and partial payments. The remaining balance drives collection priority.
Use the aging and invoice evidence to decide which account owner or simulated customer needs the next contact.
Do not add monthly A/R snapshots. A 90+ balance means more than 90 days past due, not a creditworthiness judgment.
Make assumptions visible
Example shown: raise the 90+ collection assumption from 20% to 50%. Hold the other assumed rates at 80%, 60% and 40%.
Compare with a baseline

Assumed baseline: $115,876.44.
Scenario recovery: $150,450.96.
Source A/R balances stay unchanged.
See the incremental effect
This example adds $34,574.52 in modeled recovery. Bucket balance × assumed rate produces each segment's result.
